description: This file implements the MessageControl class for the WPEFramework plugin, managing initialization, deinitialization, and message handling via WebSocket and other output mechanisms.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Main plugin class managing message control functionality, including setup and communication handlers.

classes.name: MessageControl::Config::NetworkNode
classes.description: Configuration structure for network node settings such as port and binding address.

methods.name: MessageControl::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, setting up message control, output, and WebSocket export.

methods.name: MessageControl::Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, releasing resources, unregistering callbacks, and cleaning up.

methods.name: MessageControl::Information
methods.description: Returns a string with plugin information (currently empty).

methods.description: Attaches a communication channel for WebSocket data exchange.

methods.name: MessageControl::Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound WebSocket messages, returning JSON command objects.
